messages.content: Write an incident report for a two-hour outage of a payment API caused by a expired TLS certificate. Around 200 words.

**Incident Report: Payment API Outage**

Date: 2026-09-03 | Duration: 2 hours | Severity: High

The payment API went down for two hours after the TLS certificate on the public endpoint expired. Clients could not complete the TLS handshake, so every request failed at connection time, and all payment processing stopped for the duration.

Downstream services returned errors to customers, and no transactions completed until the team restored service.

The certificate expired and requests began failing immediately. Monitoring alerted on-call once error rates spiked. On-call traced the failure to the expired certificate on the load balancer, issued a new certificate, and deployed it. The team then confirmed the service was healthy and traffic resumed.

The certificate had no automated renewal process, and no alerting system tracked its expiration date, so nobody caught the upcoming expiry before it caused the outage. The team issued a new certificate and deployed it to the load balancer, which restored TLS connectivity and ended the outage.

Three follow-up actions come out of this: add automated certificate renewal, add alerting for certificates approaching expiration with 30 days of advance warning, and audit every other production certificate for its expiration date.
